title: Existing point-completion models and checked categorical transport
statement: For a finite-field datum D, prime l and finite coefficient field E, retain the existing lifted valuation ring and completed coefficient sheaf, module and derived categories, coefficient complex, total tensor, strict quotient tower and its Roos cone. Define the actual augmentation, balancing predicate, tensor-model comparison, chi, completed pairing, inverse point tensor comparison, model complex, quotient map and both unit-coordinate and beta-completion predicates by their original formulas. The module also retains the already proved private bounded-flat, unit, naturality, cancellation and sections-transport lemmas. This is an extraction of existing constructions, with no change to any mathematical data or public signature.

source.place: Second sentence: Third paragraph, identification of the actual comparison map at integral coefficients: returned item steps 6-8, strict quotient/cone pairing square and inverse tensorator

proof.text: Use the existing lifted valuation ring, completed coefficient sheaf, module categories, localization functors and signed total tensor. The quotient tower, its specified Roos cone and actual augmentation define completion. Define chi by the augmentation followed by the balancing and tensor-model isomorphisms; define completedPairing using their inverse and the completed chain map. All formulas and public data bodies are copied verbatim from the parent module.

The bounded-flat and total K-flat criteria give good representatives. The scalar-unit coordinates, naturality of the strict quotient maps and the completed-line normalization show that the localized augmentation is invertible for constructible objects. Generic functorial cancellation proves the localized pairing square; tensorator naturality transports the sections balancing square. These are the existing fully proved private lemmas, moved without changing their proof bodies.
